expected_return.description: Probability-weighted expected forward return over the prediction horizon (gross of fees). E[r] = P(buy)*upper_return - P(sell)*lower_return; HOLD contributes 0. Lets the aggregator compute risk-adjusted expected edge. null when not computable (non triple-barrier target or insufficient history).

signal_context.description: Prediction-intrinsic forecast context — INFORMATION for downstream, not trading commands. The aggregator/risk_manager decide entry threshold, stop, position size and portfolio; this block only forecasts. Optional (absent when not computable).

horizon_bars.description: Bars the prediction looks ahead (triple-barrier h).

upper_return.description: Relative upper-barrier distance (volatility-scaled) — expected up-move magnitude.

lower_return.description: Relative lower-barrier distance — downside magnitude; a natural stop reference for risk_manager.

volatility.description: Past realized return volatility used to size the barriers.

reference_close.description: Last candle close the barriers are computed from.

calibrated.description: Whether the emitted probabilities are calibrated.
